decisions.rationale: Names the Directive rather than asserting a verdict, so it sits cleanly beside the 19 assertions that no governance document asserts legal advice or a claim. Travels across the whole locale roadmap without translating an English idiom. fairpay and equalpay were rejected for editorialising, askaboutyourpay for not travelling, article7 for being opaque and already excluding the Art. 9 employer door.

decisions.decision: Published a FRESH repository and kept the original PRIVATE as paytransparency-archive
decisions.rationale: A history rewrite cleaned the branch, but refs/pull/1..5/head still resolved to the contaminated commit. GitHub retains those independently of the head branch; they survive both branch deletion and history rewrite, and a closed PR cannot be purged via API. Reachable-only-if-you-know-to-fetch-hidden-pull-refs is obscurity, not a clean history.

decisions.decision: Art. 10(1) five-percent trigger tests MAGNITUDE, not the signed gap
decisions.rationale: Accepted by the maintainer at UAT. The signed reading would silently exempt every category in which men are the underpaid group, which the equal-pay principle does not permit. Art10Flag.gapPct carries the SIGNED value so direction is never lost.

context_notes: Phase 1 is complete and verified; this is a clean stopping point, not a mid-task pause. Working tree clean, HEAD equals origin/master equals 811552a, public repo and CI green, nightly green, 411 tests, 10/10 vectors. Nothing is half-done in code. The biggest lesson of this session: every serious defect was caught by RUNNING something, never by reasoning about it. nightly.yml was rehearsed locally and still failed at startup in CI because the runner context is invalid in an env block — only gh workflow run proved it, and the first fix was wrong too. The personal-email leak was caught by a full-history sweep placed as a pre-flight on the irreversible step. The refs/pull contamination was caught only by re-running that sweep AFTER the fix rather than trusting the fix. 12 WINDOWS entries are open on purpose and /gsd-ship blocks while they stand; they are honest limitations, not defects to tidy away.
